unitAI-6kuhd.description:
## PROBLEM

A CHILD pi process (spawned for a fresh-process proof, or any nested pi run) wedges after ANY
background-task wake and never recovers. Five occurrences in one session, each ending in a 1800s
timeout with no error reported by the child.

Throwing code: the ambient extension @narumitw/pi-goal, installed at
~/.pi/agent/npm/node_modules/@narumitw/pi-goal. It keeps a captured extension ctx across session
replacement/reload and throws on the first wake:

  "This extension ctx is stale after session replacement or reload"

The process then hangs rather than failing fast, so the symptom is a timeout, not an exception.

## WHY IT IS FILED HERE

It is NOT this repo's code and not a landing defect - but it silently breaks the fresh-process
verification pattern this project depends on for artifact-level proofs (a stale interactive session
cannot verify a rebuilt artifact, so proofs must run from a fresh child). Tracking it locally keeps
the hazard and its workaround discoverable; the actual fix belongs upstream (third-party package) or
in our pi-extensions area, and filing a public issue on a third party's tracker is the owner's call.

## WORKAROUNDS (both used successfully)

1. In the child: use a plain `sleep` + status polling loop instead of relying on a background-task
   wake.
2. More robust: have the specialist PUBLISH ITS EVIDENCE to a durable channel (Substrate journal)
   BEFORE the wake-dependent path completes. In the two proofs that mattered, the specialist had
   already published, so the dispatcher's timeout did not invalidate the evidence - the journal was
   read instead of the transcript. A timeout in the harness is not a failed proof.

## EVIDENCE

SPECIALISTS-90 and SPECIALISTS-91 both produced their full evidence and receipts despite their
dispatcher processes wedging; recorded on unitAI-1pqtl. Memory: child-pi-wedges-after-background-wake.
